title: Call for 2027 Award Nominations
content: Call for Nominations Heyscotty 2026-08-10T16:01:32+00:00 Awards at Pittcon: Call for Nominations Nominate a Colleague for One of Our Prestigious Awards Awards presented at Pittcon honor individuals for their significant contributions to analytical chemistry, spectroscopy, and bioanalytical chemistry, encompassing the introduction or advancement of techniques, theories, or instruments. Nominees from diverse backgrounds, including industry, academia, and government, are welcomed. Each awardee will curate a session featuring themselves and four esteemed collaborators in their field, further enhancing collaboration and knowledge exchange within the scientific community. These awards celebrate excellence and innovation while driving forward advancements in scientific research and education. Although nominations are ongoing, the yearly review and selection process is completed in June and July prior to the next Pittcon. Pittcon is now accepting nominations for Pittcon 2028. Pittcon Awards Pittsburgh Analytical Chemistry Award In recognition of an individual’s significant contributions to the field of analytical chemistry. Submit Nomination Program Partner Awards CACA Student Excellence and Young Investigator Awards The Chinese American Chromatography Association (CACA) is delighted to invite nominations for the 2027 CACA Student Excellence Awards (SEA) and Young Investigator Awards (YIA). Submit Nomination Pittsburgh Analytical Chemistry Award The Society for Analytical Chemists and Spectroscopists of Pittsburgh (SACSP) is accepting nominations for the Pittsburgh Analytical Chemistry Award, which will be presented at Pittcon. The purpose of the award is to recognize an individual’s significant contributions to the field of analytical chemistry, not limited to introducing or significantly expanding the application of a noteworthy technique, theory or instrument. Nominees are encouraged from all fields, including industry, academia, and government. Self-nominations are permitted. The winner will receive a cash award and travel costs to Pittcon 2028 in Boston, Massachusetts, and will be included as a speaker in the Pittsburgh Analytical Chemistry Award Symposium in his/her honor. Nominations should include: A nominating letter of reasonable length detailing the nominee’s contributions to the field of Analytical Chemistry The candidate’s CV, including list of publications At least one seconding letter, preferably two, each limited to a single sheet of paper Submit Nomination Please save everything in one PDF file, with last name in file name, before uploading your nomination. Submit Pittsburgh Spectroscopy Award The Society for Analytical Chemists and Spectroscopists of Pittsburgh (SACSP) is accepting nominations for the Pittsburgh Spectroscopy Award, which will be presented at Pittcon 2028 in Boston, Massachusetts . This award is in recognition of outstanding contributions in the field of Applied Spectroscopy. The winner will receive a cash award, travel costs to Pittcon, and will be included as a speaker in the Pittsburgh Spectroscopy Award Symposium in his/her honor. Nominees are encouraged from all fields, including industry, academia, and government. Self-nominations are permitted. Nominations should include: A nominating letter of reasonable length listing the candidate’s accomplishments in the field of Applied Spectroscopy Candidate’s vitae including list of publications At least one seconding letter, preferably two Submit Nomination Please save everything in one PDF file, with last name in file name, before uploading your nomination. Submit Pittcon Achievement Award The Society for Analytical Chemists and Spectroscopists of Pittsburgh (SACSP) is soliciting nominations for the Pittcon Achievement Award. The Award is presented annually at Pittcon to recognize individuals for outstanding achievements in the fields of analytical chemistry and/or applied spectroscopy within 10 years after completion of their Ph.D. work. To be eligible for the award, nominees must have completed their Ph.D. no earlier than March 1, 2017. The winner will be reimbursed for expenses to receive this award at Pittcon 2028 in Boston, Massachusetts. . The award winner will: Assemble the Pittcon Achievement Award symposium with a total of five speakers, including the award winner Receive an invitation to the SACP/SSP Awards Reception and Dinner during the Conference Be presented with a plaque and a cash award Submit Nomination Please save everything in one PDF file, with last name in file name, before upload
